title: Rabbit Hole
tagline: The first-of-its-kind variety show packed with epic challenges and chaos. High-s
synopsis: The first-of-its-kind variety show packed with epic challenges and chaos. High-stakes, high-key hilarious, we're going down the Rabbit Hole with your favorite creators like Topper Guild, Jesser, Dan Rhodes, Papa Jake, Matthew Beem, Mackenzie Turner, ExtraEmily, and so many more!

episodes.title: We Built a Secret Room on the Santa Monica Pier
episodes.synopsis: Topper Guild speedruns rides at Santa Monica Pier while Matthew Beem and Zhong build hidden rooms.

episodes.title: We Trained With Real Stunt Car Drivers
episodes.synopsis: Collins Key, ExtraEmily, and Dan Rhodes learn stunts at the Motion Picture Stunt Driving School.

episodes.title: Extreme Camouflage Hide and Seek
episodes.synopsis: Matthew Beem plans a chaotic hide-and-seek mansion takeover with ExtraEmily and Dan Rhodes.

episodes.title: 100 Artists vs. $1,000,000 Car
episodes.synopsis: ZHC, ExtraEmily, and Papa Jake artmog a Lamborghini, monster truck, and armored car.

episodes.title: Escaping a Real Bounty Hunter
episodes.synopsis: Topper Guild escapes bounty hunter Mike Ferguson in a chase across the beach and the Queen Mary.

episodes.title: Ultimate Trick Shot Challenge
episodes.synopsis: Mackenzie Turner teams up with That’s Amazing and Matthew Beem to build games and do trick shots.

episodes.title: We Did Magic Tricks While SkyDiving
episodes.synopsis: Josh Peck unlocks magic when Dan Rhodes and ExtraEmily free fall out of a plane.

episodes.title: Surviving a Zombie Apocalypse
episodes.synopsis: Papa Jake drops two teams into a simulated zombie apocalypse to see who can make their escape.

episodes.title: Doing Magic for an Ostrich
episodes.synopsis: Dan Rhodes mind-reads EvanTube’s drawings, then does magic for EvanTube, Mackenzie, and an ostrich.

episodes.title: We Trained Like Movie Spies
episodes.synopsis: Mackenzie Turner, Papa Jake and Sofie Dossi train with a real spy for an elite squad mission.
